description: This file contains functions for generating a billing summary report in an ERP system, including retrieving columns, data, timesheets, timesheet details, and calculating durations.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the billing summary report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes billing data based on filters, returning a list of summarized records.

methods.name: get_timesheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheet records matching the provided filters.

methods.name: get_timesheet_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed timesheet entries for specified timesheets.

methods.name: get_billable_and_total_duration
methods.description: Calculates the billable and total duration of activities within a time range.
